standingRules: Use Founder Control Room as the operational source of truth.
Treat GitHub as repository memory and evidence, not a substitute for executed proof.
Add newly discovered requirements in dependency order without deleting prior work.
Do not count zero-step workflow failures as code or test results.
Do not expose raw teen content to parents.
Do not enable unfinished L4 or L5 concepts.
